name: Polymarket prob-velocity drift — fast risk repricing leads crypto (long spot)
rationale: EVENT-STUDY / DRIFT. pm_prob_velocity is the SPEED at which prediction-market odds on macro/risk events are repricing — the derivative of belief, which by construction leads the slow-moving spot price (beliefs update in the prediction market before they propagate into a single asset's price). A positive prob-velocity spike = the crowd is rapidly pricing IN a risk-on/bullish-macro outcome; the underlying crypto then drifts up over the following days as that belief shift gets arbitraged into price (post-information drift). Mechanism before data: long spot when pm_prob_velocity crosses UP through a fitted velocity floor (fast bullish repricing) AND crypto momentum confirms the drift has started; exit when velocity decays (repricing done) or barriers fire. Distinct from polymarket-positioning-risk-flip (pm_implied_prob LEVEL + momentum — the static odds, not their velocity). The novelty is using the VELOCITY (the event-study leading edge), not the level. Disconfirmer 1: replace pm_prob_velocity with pm_implied_prob level — if the static read matches the deflated Sharpe, velocity adds nothing and this duplicates the positioning spec. Disconfirmer 2: drop the momentum arm — if a bare velocity spike matches, it is not a confirmed drift. Disconfirmer 3 (PIT/cost): Polymarket CLOB snapshot is PIT (no lag); net of ~20bps the drift must clear. tier0 pm_prob_velocity + tier0 ret_Nd, fresh prod data (polymarket), unproven combination — low-confidence until OOS.
catalyst: pm_prob_velocity crosses up (fast bullish risk repricing in the prediction market) WHILE crypto momentum confirms the drift — long spot
